```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
```

# Settings

```{r settings}
# RDS files produced by prepare_all_datasets.Rmd
datasets <- c(
  Mouse     = "data/mouse_sr_correlations.rds",
  iNeuron   = "data/neuron_sr_correlations.rds",
  LongBench = "data/longbench_sr_correlations.rds"
)

dir_data   <- "data"
dir_plots  <- "plots"
dir_tables <- "tables"   # supplementary tables and source data
for (d in c(dir_data, dir_plots, dir_tables)) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Reference levels (treatment coding and trt.vs.ctrl contrasts)
ref_tool <- "bambu"
ref_norm <- "CPM"
ref_tech <- "ont"

# Recommended normalization per platform (tool-level analysis)
rec_norm <- c(ont = "CPM", ont_drna = "CPM", kinnex = "TPM", isoseq = "TPM")

# Tool groups for the quantifiers vs reconstruction contrast
quant_tools <- c("kallisto", "oarfish")
recon_tools <- c("bambu", "flair", "isoquant")

# Column that separates gene- and transcript-level rows in the RDS, if any
# (e.g. "Level"). NULL = descriptive medians are not split.
level_col <- NULL

alpha <- 0.05

# Cohort order in figures
cohort_order_emm     <- c("Mouse", "iNeuron", "LongBench")
cohort_order_heatmap <- c("Mouse", "LongBench", "iNeuron")

# Satterthwaite df (same as lmerTest); keep it for models > 3000 obs
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 1e5)
```

# Helpers

```{r helpers}
# ---- Display labels ----
tool_labels <- c(bambu = "Bambu", flair = "FLAIR", isoquant = "IsoQuant",
                 kallisto = "Kallisto", oarfish = "Oarfish")
norm_labels <- c(CPM = "CPM", cqn = "CQN", EDA = "EDASeq",
                 ratio_counts = "SMR", TPM = "TPM")
tech_labels <- c(ont = "cDNA ONT", kinnex = "Kinnex",
                 isoseq = "Iso-Seq", ont_drna = "dRNA ONT")
all_labels  <- c(tool_labels, norm_labels, tech_labels)

relabel <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- unname(all_labels[x])
  ifelse(is.na(out), x, out)
}

# ---- Contrast strings ----
strip_par <- function(x) gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", x)

# "A - B" -> level1 = A, level2 = B
split_contrast <- function(ct) {
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(ct), " - ", fixed = TRUE)
  tibble(level1 = strip_par(sapply(parts, `[`, 1)),
         level2 = strip_par(sapply(parts, `[`, 2)))
}

pretty_contrast <- function(ct) {
  p <- split_contrast(ct)
  ifelse(is.na(p$level2), as.character(ct),
         paste(relabel(p$level1), "-", relabel(p$level2)))
}

# Add *_label columns for the factors present and for the contrast
add_labels <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(c("Technology", "Normalization", "Tool")),
                  relabel, .names = "{.col}_label"))
  if ("contrast" %in% names(df)) df$contrast_label <- pretty_contrast(df$contrast)
  df
}

# emmeans summary -> tibble. Test statistic is called t.ratio (finite df)
# or z.ratio (asymptotic df); rename both to `stat` so tables can be bound.
tidy_ct <- function(ct, cohort) {
  as.data.frame(summary(ct, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(any_of(c(stat = "t.ratio", stat = "z.ratio"))) %>%
    mutate(Cohort = cohort, .before = 1)
}

# Keep only the recommended normalization of each platform
keep_rec <- function(df) {
  df %>% filter(Normalization == rec_norm[as.character(Technology)])
}

# ---- Nakagawa R2 for a Gaussian random-intercept lmer ----
r2_nakagawa_lmer <- function(m) {
  var_f <- var(predict(m, re.form = NA))
  var_r <- sum(sapply(VarCorr(m), function(v) sum(diag(v))))
  var_e <- sigma(m)^2
  tibble(R2_marginal    = var_f / (var_f + var_r + var_e),
         R2_conditional = (var_f + var_r) / (var_f + var_r + var_e))
}

# ---- Marginal main effects and interaction contrasts (Supp. Fig. 14) ----
# Term names follow lmer's coefficient names ("Toolflair",
# "Normalizationcqn:Technologykinnex") so they can be matched to the betas.
emm_main <- function(m, f, cohort) {
  tidy_ct(contrast(emmeans(m, specs = f), method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
                   adjust = "holm"), cohort) %>%
    mutate(Term = paste0(f, split_contrast(contrast)$level1))
}

emm_int <- function(m, f1, f2, cohort) {
  ct <- tidy_ct(contrast(emmeans(m, specs = c(f1, f2)),
                         interaction = c("trt.vs.ctrl", "trt.vs.ctrl"),
                         adjust = "holm"), cohort)
  c1 <- grep(paste0("^", f1, "_"), names(ct), value = TRUE)
  c2 <- grep(paste0("^", f2, "_"), names(ct), value = TRUE)
  ct %>%
    mutate(Term = paste0(f1, split_contrast(.data[[c1]])$level1, ":",
                         f2, split_contrast(.data[[c2]])$level1)) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(c1, c2)))
}
```

# Fit models

```{r fit_models}
models <- list(); raw_list <- list()
anova_list <- list(); r2_list <- list()

for (name in names(datasets)) {
  dat <- readRDS(datasets[[name]]) %>%
    mutate(
      Technology    = relevel(factor(Dataset), ref = ref_tech),
      Tool          = relevel(factor(Tool), ref = ref_tool),
      Normalization = relevel(factor(Normalization), ref = ref_norm),
      Correlation_z = atanh(Correlation),
      Cohort        = name
    )
  missing_rec <- setdiff(levels(dat$Technology), names(rec_norm))
  if (length(missing_rec)) stop("No recommended normalization for: ", toString(missing_rec))
  raw_list[[name]] <- dat

  m <- lmer(Correlation_z ~ Tool * Normalization + Tool * Technology +
              Normalization * Technology + (1 | Sample), data = dat)
  models[[name]] <- m
  saveRDS(m, file.path(dir_data, paste0(name, "_lmer_model.rds")))

  anova_list[[name]] <- as.data.frame(anova(m, type = 3)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Term") %>% mutate(Cohort = name, .before = 1)
  r2_list[[name]] <- r2_nakagawa_lmer(m) %>% mutate(Cohort = name, .before = 1)
}

model_r2 <- bind_rows(r2_list)

# Type III ANOVA, terms ordered by F within cohort
anova_table <- bind_rows(anova_list) %>%
  arrange(factor(Cohort, levels = cohort_order_emm), desc(`F value`))

anova_table
model_r2
```

# emmeans contrasts

```{r contrasts}
res <- list(heatmap = list(), emm_nt = list(), norm_vs_cpm = list(),
            norm_pairs = list(), tool_emm = list(), tool_pairs = list(),
            tool_groups = list())

for (name in names(models)) {
  m <- models[[name]]

  # Supp. Fig. 14: marginal main effects vs reference + interaction contrasts
  # (Holm adjustment within each term type, i.e. each block of the heatmap)
  res$heatmap[[name]] <- bind_rows(
    emm_main(m, "Tool", name),
    emm_main(m, "Normalization", name),
    emm_main(m, "Technology", name),
    emm_int(m, "Tool", "Normalization", name),
    emm_int(m, "Tool", "Technology", name),
    emm_int(m, "Normalization", "Technology", name)
  )

  # Supp. Figs. 15-16: EMMs of each normalization x technology cell
  res$emm_nt[[name]] <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m, ~ Normalization * Technology)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>% mutate(Cohort = name, .before = 1)

  # Normalization simple effects within each technology
  emm_norm <- emmeans(m, ~ Normalization | Technology)
  res$norm_vs_cpm[[name]] <- tidy_ct(contrast(emm_norm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl"), name) # Dunnett
  res$norm_pairs[[name]]  <- tidy_ct(pairs(emm_norm), name)                            # Tukey

  # Tools under the recommended normalization of each platform
  emm_tool <- emmeans(m, ~ Tool | Technology * Normalization)
  res$tool_emm[[name]] <- as.data.frame(emm_tool) %>% as_tibble() %>%
    keep_rec() %>%
    mutate(Cohort = name, .before = 1,
           r = tanh(emmean), r_lower = tanh(lower.CL), r_upper = tanh(upper.CL))
  res$tool_pairs[[name]] <- tidy_ct(pairs(emm_tool), name) %>% keep_rec()       # Tukey

  # mean(quantifiers) - mean(reconstruction); single test per cell
  lv <- levels(emm_tool)$Tool
  w  <- ifelse(lv %in% quant_tools, 1 / sum(lv %in% quant_tools),
        ifelse(lv %in% recon_tools, -1 / sum(lv %in% recon_tools), 0))
  res$tool_groups[[name]] <- tidy_ct(
    contrast(emm_tool, list(quant_vs_recon = w)), name) %>% keep_rec()
}

res <- lapply(res, function(x) add_labels(bind_rows(x)))
```

# Descriptive medians (raw correlations)

```{r medians}
raw_all <- bind_rows(raw_list)

# Per cohort, technology and normalization
medians_norm <- raw_all %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c(level_col, "Cohort", "Technology", "Normalization")))) %>%
  summarise(median = median(Correlation), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pooled across cohorts ("overall cross-cohort sample median")
medians_norm_pooled <- raw_all %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c(level_col, "Technology", "Normalization")))) %>%
  summarise(median = median(Correlation), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Per tool under the recommended normalization
medians_tool_rec <- raw_all %>%
  keep_rec() %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c(level_col, "Cohort", "Technology", "Normalization", "Tool")))) %>%
  summarise(median = median(Correlation), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

medians_norm        <- add_labels(medians_norm)
medians_norm_pooled <- add_labels(medians_norm_pooled)
medians_tool_rec    <- add_labels(medians_tool_rec)
```

# Figures

```{r theme_and_colors}
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm")
    )
}

tech_colors <- c("cDNA ONT" = "#4A5899", "Kinnex" = "#e31c93",
                 "Iso-Seq" = "#EE7B30", "dRNA ONT" = "#56B4E9")
tech_shapes <- c("cDNA ONT" = 16, "Kinnex" = 17, "Iso-Seq" = 15, "dRNA ONT" = 18)
```

```{r emm_plots}
all_emms <- res$emm_nt %>%
  mutate(
    Technology_label    = factor(Technology_label, levels = unname(tech_labels)),
    Normalization_label = factor(Normalization_label, levels = unname(norm_labels)),
    Cohort              = factor(Cohort, levels = cohort_order_emm)
  )

plot_emm <- function(df) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Normalization_label, y = emmean,
                 color = Technology_label, shape = Technology_label,
                 group = Technology_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                  width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2.0, fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ Cohort, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = tech_colors, name = "Technology") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = tech_shapes, name = "Technology") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "EMM (Fisher z′)") +
    theme_nature()
}

# Supplementary Fig. 15: CPM vs TPM
p_supp15 <- all_emms %>%
  filter(Normalization %in% c("CPM", "TPM")) %>%
  mutate(Normalization_label = droplevels(Normalization_label)) %>%
  plot_emm()

# Supplementary Fig. 16: CPM vs CQN vs EDASeq
p_supp16 <- all_emms %>%
  filter(Normalization %in% c("CPM", "cqn", "EDA")) %>%
  mutate(Normalization_label = droplevels(Normalization_label)) %>%
  plot_emm()
```

```{r heatmap}
factor_names <- c("Tool", "Normalization", "Technology")
ref_of <- c(Tool = ref_tool, Normalization = ref_norm, Technology = ref_tech)

parse_term <- function(term) {
  lapply(strsplit(term, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], function(p) {
    f <- factor_names[startsWith(p, factor_names)][1]
    list(f = f, lvl = sub(paste0("^", f), "", p))
  })
}

term_label <- function(term) {
  pp <- parse_term(term)
  if (length(pp) == 1) {
    paste0(relabel(pp[[1]]$lvl), " (vs. ", relabel(ref_of[[pp[[1]]$f]]), ")")
  } else {
    paste(sapply(pp, function(x) relabel(x$lvl)), collapse = " × ")
  }
}

term_type <- function(term) {
  fs <- sapply(parse_term(term), `[[`, "f")
  if (length(fs) == 1) paste(fs, "Effects") else paste(fs, collapse = " × ")
}

term_type_order <- c("Tool Effects", "Normalization Effects", "Technology Effects",
                     "Tool × Normalization", "Tool × Technology",
                     "Normalization × Technology")

colors_signif <- c("Significant (Positive)" = "#DE2D26",
                   "NS (adj. p ≥ 0.05)"       = "#F0F0F0",
                   "Significant (Negative)" = "#3182BD")

heatmap_data <- res$heatmap %>%
  mutate(
    TermLabel = sapply(Term, term_label),
    TermType  = factor(sapply(Term, term_type), levels = term_type_order),
    PValCat   = case_when(
      p.value < alpha & estimate > 0 ~ "Significant (Positive)",
      p.value < alpha & estimate < 0 ~ "Significant (Negative)",
      TRUE                           ~ "NS (adj. p ≥ 0.05)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Cohort, TermLabel, TermType, estimate, PValCat) %>%
  # empty cells for terms absent in a cohort (e.g. Iso-Seq outside Mouse)
  complete(Cohort = cohort_order_heatmap, nesting(TermLabel, TermType),
           fill = list(PValCat = "NS (adj. p ≥ 0.05)")) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort       = factor(Cohort, levels = cohort_order_heatmap),
    PValCat      = factor(PValCat, levels = names(colors_signif)),
    EstimateText = ifelse(is.na(estimate), "", sprintf("%.3f", estimate))
  )

# Supplementary Fig. 14
p_supp14 <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Cohort, y = TermLabel, fill = PValCat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = EstimateText), size = 1.8, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(TermType ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_signif, name = "Significance", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Dataset", y = "emmeans contrast (Δz′)") +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 6.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm")
  )
```

# Supplementary tables and source data

```{r export_tables}
# ---- Formatting helpers ----
# Tukey/Dunnett p-values below ~1e-12 are at the numerical floor, so they
# are written as "< 1e-12" instead of an exact value
fmt_p_col <- function(p, floor = 1e-12) {
  ifelse(p < floor, paste0("< ", format(floor, scientific = TRUE)),
         formatC(p, format = "g", digits = 3))
}

quant_label <- paste0("Quantifiers (", toString(relabel(quant_tools)), ") - ",
                      "reconstruction (", toString(relabel(recon_tools)), ")")

clean_contrasts <- function(x, adjustment) {
  out <- tibble(Cohort = x$Cohort, Platform = relabel(x$Technology))
  if ("Normalization" %in% names(x)) out$Normalization <- relabel(x$Normalization)
  out %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast       = ifelse(x$contrast == "quant_vs_recon", quant_label, x$contrast_label),
      `Δz′`          = round(x$estimate, 4),
      SE             = round(x$SE, 4),
      df             = round(x$df, 1),
      `95% CI lower` = round(x$lower.CL, 4),
      `95% CI upper` = round(x$upper.CL, 4),
      t              = round(x$stat, 2),
      `Adjusted p`   = fmt_p_col(x$p.value),
      Adjustment     = adjustment
    )
}

pretty_anova_term <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub(":", " × ", x)
  gsub("Technology", "Platform", x)
}

# ---- Supplementary Table 1: ANOVA and R2 ----
supp_table_1 <- list(
  `ANOVA (Type III)` = anova_table %>%
    transmute(Cohort,
              Term      = pretty_anova_term(Term),
              `Sum Sq`  = signif(`Sum Sq`, 4),
              `Mean Sq` = signif(`Mean Sq`, 4),
              `Num df`  = NumDF,
              `Den df`  = round(DenDF, 1),
              F         = round(`F value`, 2),
              p         = formatC(`Pr(>F)`, format = "g", digits = 3)),
  `R2 (Nakagawa)` = model_r2 %>%
    transmute(Cohort,
              `Marginal R2`    = round(R2_marginal, 3),
              `Conditional R2` = round(R2_conditional, 3))
)

# ---- Supplementary Table 2: normalization contrasts within each platform ----
supp_table_2 <- list(
  `vs CPM (Dunnett)` = clean_contrasts(res$norm_vs_cpm, "Dunnett"),
  `Pairwise (Tukey)` = clean_contrasts(res$norm_pairs, "Tukey")
)

# ---- Supplementary Table 3: tools under the recommended normalization ----
supp_table_3 <- list(
  `Quant vs reconstruction` = clean_contrasts(res$tool_groups, "None (single test)"),
  `Tool pairwise (Tukey)`   = clean_contrasts(res$tool_pairs, "Tukey")
)

# ---- Source data for figures and descriptive values in the text ----
source_data <- list(
  `Supp Fig 14` = res$heatmap %>%
    transmute(Cohort,
              `Term type`    = sapply(Term, term_type),
              Term           = sapply(Term, term_label),
              `Δz′`          = round(estimate, 4),
              SE             = round(SE, 4),
              df             = round(df, 1),
              `95% CI lower` = round(lower.CL, 4),
              `95% CI upper` = round(upper.CL, 4),
              t              = round(stat, 2),
              `Holm p`       = formatC(p.value, format = "g", digits = 3)),
  `Supp Fig 15-16 EMMs` = res$emm_nt %>%
    transmute(Cohort,
              Platform       = Technology_label,
              Normalization  = Normalization_label,
              `EMM (z′)`     = round(emmean, 4),
              SE             = round(SE, 4),
              df             = round(df, 1),
              `95% CI lower` = round(lower.CL, 4),
              `95% CI upper` = round(upper.CL, 4),
              `EMM (r)`      = round(tanh(emmean), 3)),
  `Tool EMMs rec norm` = res$tool_emm %>%
    transmute(Cohort,
              Platform           = Technology_label,
              Normalization      = Normalization_label,
              Tool               = Tool_label,
              `EMM (z′)`         = round(emmean, 4),
              SE                 = round(SE, 4),
              `EMM (r)`          = round(r, 3),
              `95% CI lower (r)` = round(r_lower, 3),
              `95% CI upper (r)` = round(r_upper, 3)),
  `Medians by cohort` = medians_norm %>%
    transmute(across(any_of(level_col)), Cohort,
              Platform = Technology_label, Normalization = Normalization_label,
              Median = round(median, 3), n),
  `Medians pooled` = medians_norm_pooled %>%
    transmute(across(any_of(level_col)),
              Platform = Technology_label, Normalization = Normalization_label,
              Median = round(median, 3), n),
  `Medians tools rec norm` = medians_tool_rec %>%
    transmute(across(any_of(level_col)), Cohort,
              Platform = Technology_label, Normalization = Normalization_label,
              Tool = Tool_label, Median = round(median, 3), n)
)

# ---- Write: one .xlsx per table (one sheet per panel) + one CSV per sheet ----
write_table_set <- function(sheets, name) {
  if (requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, file.path(dir_tables, paste0(name, ".xlsx")))
  }
  for (sh in names(sheets)) {
    csv_name <- gsub("_+", "_", paste0(name, "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", sh)))
    write_excel_csv(sheets[[sh]], file.path(dir_tables, paste0(sub("_$", "", csv_name), ".csv")))
  }
}

write_table_set(supp_table_1, "Supplementary_Table_1")
write_table_set(supp_table_2, "Supplementary_Table_2")
write_table_set(supp_table_3, "Supplementary_Table_3")
write_table_set(source_data,  "Source_Data")
```

```{r export_plots}
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 80, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4
  f <- function(ext) file.path(dir_plots, paste0(filename, ext))

  ggsave(f(".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)

  svglite::svglite(f(".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot); dev.off()

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(f(".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot); dev.off()

  ragg::agg_tiff(f(".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot); dev.off()
}

save_pub_r(p_supp14, "Supplementary_Figure_14", height_mm = 240)
save_pub_r(p_supp15, "Supplementary_Figure_15", height_mm = 85)
save_pub_r(p_supp16, "Supplementary_Figure_16", height_mm = 85)
```
